info.name: Internship Manager
info.description:
# Internship Manager API

A comprehensive REST API for managing the full lifecycle of student internships — from subject proposals and candidatures through to formal affectations and completion.

## Overview

The Internship Manager API supports three types of users:

- **Students** — Browse internship subjects, submit candidatures, propose their own subjects, communicate with teachers, and track their affectation.
    
- **Teachers** — Propose and manage internship subjects, review and act on student candidatures, communicate with students, and monitor their supervision workload.
    
- **Administrators** — Manage user accounts, oversee all subjects and candidatures, process affectations, and access system-wide statistics.
    

## Authentication

All protected endpoints require a JWT Bearer token. Obtain a token by calling the **login** endpoint under the `Auth` folder. Include it in every subsequent request as:

```
Authorization: Bearer <your_token>

 ```

## Base URL

Requests use the `{{localUrl}}` variable as the base URL. Set this in your active environment (e.g., `http://localhost:8080`). Each folder also uses a path prefix variable (e.g., `{{auth}}`, `{{users}}`, `{{subjects}}`, `{{candidature}}`, `{{message}}`, `{{affectations}}`).

## Folder Structure

| Folder | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Auth** | Login and registration for teachers and students |
| **User Management** | CRUD operations and account status management |
| **Subjects** | Internship subject proposals, browsing, and management |
| **Candidature** | Student applications and teacher review workflow |
| **Messagerie** | In-platform messaging between students and teachers |
| **Affectation** | Formal assignment management, workload tracking, and statistics |

item.description: Contains all authentication-related endpoints for the Internship Manager API. Handles user login and registration for both teachers and students. All endpoints in this folder return a JWT token upon success, which must be used as a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header for all protected routes throughout the API.

response.name: Deactivate

item.description: Contains endpoints for managing internship subjects. Teachers can propose new subjects, view their own subjects, and update or delete them. Students can browse all available subjects with pagination, view subject details, and submit their own subject proposals to a specific teacher. Subject IDs are passed as path variables in most endpoints.

response.name: Postuler

request.description: Accepts a student's candidature for an internship subject, identified by the candidature ID in the URL path (e.g., `/candidature/1/accepter`). Used by teachers or administrators to approve an application. Once accepted, the student is assigned to the subject.

Cancels and removes a candidature identified by its ID in the URL path (e.g., `/candidature/2`). Used by students to withdraw their application before it is processed. This action is irreversible and removes the candidature record from the system.

Requests clarification on a candidature identified by its ID in the URL path (e.g., `/candidature/1/clarifier`). Used by teachers or administrators to ask the student for additional information before making a decision. Updates the candidature status to reflect the pending clarification.

Rejects a student's candidature for an internship subject, identified by the candidature ID in the URL path (e.g., `/candidature/5/refuser`). Used by teachers or administrators to decline an application. The student is notified and the candidature status is updated to refused.

item.description: Contains endpoints for managing student candidatures (applications) for internship subjects. Students can apply to subjects, view their own applications, and cancel them. Teachers and administrators can accept, refuse, or request clarification on candidatures. Candidature IDs are passed as path variables for status-change operations.

item.name: Messagerie

request.description: Sends a message in a conversation thread identified by the conversation/subject ID in the URL path (e.g., `/message/1`). Used by students and teachers to communicate within the context of an internship subject or candidature. The message content is sent in the request body.

Deletes a specific message identified by its ID in the URL path (e.g., `/message/2`). Used by the message author or an administrator to remove a message from a conversation thread. This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

Retrieves all messages in a conversation thread identified by the subject/conversation ID in the URL path (e.g., `/message/1/all`). Supports pagination via the `page` query parameter (e.g., `?page=2`). Used by students and teachers to view the full message history of a thread.

item.description: Contains endpoints for the internal messaging system, enabling communication between students and teachers within the context of internship subjects. Users can send messages to a conversation thread, retrieve paginated message history, and delete individual messages. Conversation threads are identified by a subject or thread ID passed as a path variable.

item.name: Affectation

request.description: Retrieves the workload summary for the currently authenticated teacher, showing how many students they are supervising across their assigned internship subjects. Used by teachers and administrators to monitor supervision capacity and balance assignments.

Retrieves the internship affectation (assignment) for the currently authenticated student. Returns details about the subject, supervising teacher, and current status of the internship. The student's identity is derived from the JWT token.

Retrieves a list of students who have accepted candidatures but have not yet been formally assigned to an internship subject. Used by administrators to identify and process pending affectations. Helps ensure no student falls through the cracks during the assignment phase.

Aborts (cancels) an active internship affectation identified by its ID in the URL path (e.g., `/affectations/6/abort`). Used by administrators to terminate an ongoing assignment before completion. This action updates the affectation status and may free up the subject for reassignment.

Marks an internship affectation as completed, identified by its ID in the URL path (e.g., `/affectations/7/complete`). Used by teachers or administrators to officially close out an internship once the student has finished. Updates the affectation status to completed.

Returns aggregated statistics about internship affectations, including counts by status (e.g., active, completed, aborted). Used by administrators and coordinators to get a high-level overview of the internship program's progress and distribution.

Retrieves the affectation workload from a student's perspective, showing the distribution of students across internship subjects. Used by administrators and coordinators to monitor how students are distributed among available subjects and supervising teachers.

item.description: Contains endpoints for managing internship affectations (formal assignments of students to internship subjects). Administrators can view unassigned students, abort active affectations, and mark them as complete. Teachers can check their supervision workload. Students can view their own affectation. Statistical endpoints provide aggregate counts for program-level reporting.
